newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - October 9.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - October 9.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse was at 7.4 million zlotys.
The following is a summary of block transactions on the Warsaw bourse on Wednesday:
* 50,000 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on May 9, 1998 trading at 102.30 zlotys.
* 20.000 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on November 9, 1997 trading at 101.70 zlotys.
